ORDINANCE SEPr 13,2023
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-2 Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Maps No. 12-L, in
area bounded by

A line 100.00 feet south of and parallel to West 52nd Street Street; South Luna
Avenue; A line 150.00 feet south of and parallel to West 52nd Street; and the alley
next west of and parallel to South Luna Avenue

To those of a RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its
passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 5210-5212 S. Luna Ave., Chicago, IL 60638
